expectations.text: States that a written agreement or reminder is not enforcement
expectations.evidence: "Training degrades. You've done the training... No one has to remember to run the formatter. No one has to read CONTRIBUTING.md. No one has to hear standup."

expectations.text: Recommends a pre-commit hook to run the formatter automatically
expectations.evidence: "Pre-commit hook (catches it locally, friction-free)... Runs the formatter and type-checker on staged files"

expectations.text: Notes that pre-commit is bypassable with --no-verify and must be backed by a CI check
expectations.evidence: Mentions CI catches what slips past but does not explain the --no-verify bypass mechanism

expectations.text: Recommends a type check as a required CI check
expectations.evidence: "Blocks merge if code is unformatted or untyped"

expectations.text: Recommends baselining or ratcheting rather than enforcing across the whole repo at once
Notes that branch protection is what makes a CI check actually required
Recommends the failure message tell the developer how to fix it
Does not primarily recommend rewriting CONTRIBUTING.md, more reminders, or more discipline
expectations.evidence: "Skip the 'add this to your mental checklist' framing entirely"
